info.title: CPM Auth
info.description: Go auth service. JWT RS256, organization/division contexts. No rate limits. Cookie and CORS handling belongs to the future BFF.

post.summary: Login and choose an available context

post.description: Each successful selection increments session context_version, including selecting the current context. All previous access generations remain invalid after returning to a previous context. Concurrent selections with the same access have one winner; the other returns 401. Refresh token is preserved and is not returned here.

OperationBinding.description: Exact Rev2 discriminated type/target/proof/nullable metadata rules in docs/import-operation-grants-v1.md. Null fields are required. Scope is derived from the live initiator, never submitted. Division IDs must be numerically sorted and include origin. Duplicate, escaped-duplicate, unknown and case-aliased JSON fields are rejected.
